title: Brute who chucked glass bottle at NYPD officer’s head in Queens arrested
text:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

The brutish dunderhead who chucked a glass bottle at an NYPD cop’s head at a Queens public housing complex in early September was arrested and charged Friday, police said.

Robert Zuniga, 27, allegedly hurled the bottle at a 29-year-old officer responding to a fight at the NYCHA  Ravenswood Houses around 12:45 a.m. on Sept. 6, cops said.

The cop was attempting to disperse a chaotic crowd when Zuniga allegedly launched his attack.

The officer was left with a bad cut and had to be hospitalized.

Zuniga — who lives in Astoria — was charged with assault on a police officer, attempted assault, criminal possession of a weapon and harassment.
